audit.whatIsWrong: Every row disagreed with its own why: whys[0..4] all claim the stage for Volibear while the rows read Skill, Singed, Singed, Skill, Skill.
audit.why: The mirror audit (singed__volibear) already resolved the chart as Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Singed, Singed for rows 0-4. Restating it from this side keeps the two pages consistent, and it is defensible on the kit: rows 3 and 4 are where Fling's 10s cooldown and then Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds take the lane off you.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 set to Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Singed, Singed with paired layers; rows 5-6 stay Singed. whys[1..4] and phases[3..4].why rewritten so each row now argues its own side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your spike ('R-into-Q catch and you kill him') with no mention of Insanity Potion.
audit.why: Insanity Potion is a 100s cooldown that grants combat stats AND makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds. Frenzied Maul's second-bite heal is the engine of every extended trade you take, so his ult directly disables your sustain for its duration. Level 6 is his spike, not yours.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[4].why, whys[4] and spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] called his escape 'Flip + Fling W' — two names for one ability, and the wrong slot. wants.you[2] called Mega Adhesive 'his Flip (W)'. Nothing anywhere mentioned grounding.
audit.why: Fling is E (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s), Mega Adhesive is W (17/16/15/14/13s) and it grounds. Grounding shuts off Stormbringer — never leap onto the glue. It does NOT stop Thundering Smash: Riot's text is 'gains speed towards enemies' with no dash, so only the glue's slow shortens your approach.
audit.corrected: Slots and names fixed; grounding-vs-Stormbringer and the non-dash Q stated with real cooldowns.

edits.before: Level 2 stays yours as you gain E and can start slow-locking him before he ramps poison.
edits.after: Level 2 stays yours — Q plus W out-trades a Singed who only has Poison Trail ticking.

edits.before: Level 3 is firmly yours: E slow into Q stun removes the Fling escape he depends on.
edits.after: Level 3 evens out — Mega Adhesive's slow lands first and drags your Q approach short.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 favour you because his kiting is neutralized every time you land the Q stun.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 go to him: Fling is 10s at rank 1 and flips you out of every commit.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you when R-into-Q lands, converting his lack of mobility into a kill before he stacks speed.
edits.after: Level 6 is his: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so your W re-bite stops healing.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Singed down every time Fling is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks chunk hard, but Fling is only 10s at rank 1 — commit inside that window or he flips you into the goo and walks off.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Singed under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Insanity Potion turns Poison Trail into Grievous Wounds and guts the Frenzied Maul heal for 25s. Fight him before he drinks, never after.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then Q-stun. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10s at rank 1. - Singed Mega Adhesive: 17s, and its grounding denies your Stormbringer leap.

edits.before: His flip. Bait it, then Q-stun. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling is 10s at rank 1 — bait it, then walk him down inside it.

edits.before: Track his Flip (W) cooldown and all-in when it's down
edits.after: Never leap Stormbringer onto his Mega Adhesive

edits.before: You hard-counter Singed's fling: E Sky Splitter slow plus Q Thundering Smash stun pins him in place so he can't kite through poison. Every stun means free W Frenzied Maul bleeds while his only escape (Flip + Fling W) is on cooldown.
edits.after: You pin Singed: Sky Splitter's slow plus the Thundering Smash stun stops him kiting through poison, and Mega Adhesive's grounding does nothing to Q — it is a speed boost, not a dash. Every stun buys free Frenzied Maul bites while Fling's 10s runs down.

edits.before: R Stormbringer's leap and slow catch Singed even after he pops Ghost and W Mega Adhesive. If you have your Q stun up, 6 is a clean kill window before he builds enough MS and HP to run forever.
edits.after: Insanity Potion is a 100s cooldown that makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, cutting the Frenzied Maul heal for its whole duration. Fight him before he drinks, and never leap Stormbringer into Mega Adhesive.

notes: Stormbringer carries a dash flag and Mega Adhesive grounds, so the glue hard-denies your ult engage — that interaction was absent from the entire entry and is now in three fields. Thundering Smash is not a dash, so grounding does not touch it; only the slow does.
